script.end_question: Aapne kabhi US stock kharida hai? Haan ya na?
script.hook: Bhai ne January mein phone kholke kaha, ab main America mein invest karunga.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: BHAI in his hoodie sits on a sofa at night, holding his phone up excitedly, a confident grin, a small tea cup on the side table, warm living room light

scenes.vo: Bhai ne January mein phone kholke kaha, ab main America mein invest karunga.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: Close-up of a phone screen glowing in a dark room, endless reels of young men pointing at rising charts and skyscrapers, BHAI's face lit by the screen, eyes wide with hope

scenes.vo: Reels pe sab yahi bol rahe the, US stocks mein hi asli paisa hai.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI scrolling a stock app, his thumb hovering over a company logo surrounded by floating digital advertisement banners, a tall American office tower in the background, determined look

scenes.vo: Usne ek bada naam chuna, The Trade Desk, online ads wali company.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI explaining to BEHEN at the dining table, counting points on his fingers, a dollar note and a rupee note side by side on the table, BEHEN in office wear listening with raised eyebrow, evening

scenes.vo: Logic seedha tha, America ki company hai, dollar mein kamaati hai, toh safe hai.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: Close-up of BHAI's thumb pressing a big green button on a phone app, tiny confetti animation on screen, his satisfied smile reflected in the glass

scenes.vo: Aur upar se app pe button dabao, share aapke paas, koi jhanjhat nahi.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: BHAI frozen on the balcony at dawn, staring at his phone showing a steep red line falling off a cliff, mouth open, cold blue morning light

scenes.vo: Phir is saal ke andar hi, wahi share 65.75 percent gir chuka tha.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: A glass piggy bank on a table, two thirds of the coins visibly vanishing into smoke, only a small pile left at the bottom, BHAI's hand reaching toward it in disbelief

scenes.vo: Matlab jitna lagaya, uska aadha bhi nahi bacha, ek tihaai ke aas paas.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: A row of tall glass company towers crumbling like sandcastles under a stormy sky, a gambling chip, a car and a yoga mat tumbling down with them, dramatic dusk

scenes.vo: Woh akela nahi tha, kai bade naam aadhe se zyada gire.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: SG in his striped shirt sits beside BHAI on the sofa, calmly drawing a zigzag line on a notepad, BHAI watching quietly, soft lamp light

scenes.vo: Volatility yaani share ka tez upar neeche hona, woh desh dekh kar nahi aati.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: A tiny paper boat with an American flag sail tossed by huge waves next to an equally tossed Indian boat, both rocking the same, stormy sea at night

scenes.vo: Twist yeh hai, bada naam aur bada desh, risk ko chhota nahi karta.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: BEHEN at a desk with a laptop and a calculator, a paper airplane made of a rupee note flying toward a globe, her expression thoughtful and careful, afternoon light

scenes.vo: Bahar paisa bhejne pe tax ke niyam bhi alag hain, toh poora hisaab pehle samjho.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: MUMMY in a saree in the kitchen gently spreading eggs across several small baskets, BHAI watching and nodding slowly, warm morning sunlight

scenes.vo: Ek basket mein sab ande mat rakho. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.label: END

visual.prompt: BHAI looks straight out of the panel holding his phone, half smiling half embarrassed, the red chart faded behind him, soft evening light

scenes.vo: Aapne kabhi US stock kharida hai? Haan ya na?
